prerequisites.reason: Activation functions are essential for understanding how neural networks process information.
Loss functions are needed to compute the error used in backpropagation.
Backpropagation is a key algorithm used for training neural networks.
Understanding training techniques is necessary to evaluate model performance effectively.
Deep learning is fundamentally based on neural networks.
Hyperparameter optimization is a crucial aspect of training techniques.
Regularization techniques are part of the strategies used in training models.
Effective training techniques are necessary for making accurate predictions during inference.
